LanguageData.FeatherTrophies_Scalping_GizmoDesc: Order a colonist to scalp this person. Anyone able to cut flesh will take the job.
LanguageData.FeatherTrophies_Scalping_DesignatorDesc: Order colonists to scalp every person and corpse in the area that can be scalped.
LanguageData.FeatherTrophies_Scalping_Provoked: People of {PLAYERFACTION_name} have attempted to scalp {TARGET_nameDef}, and {TARGET_pronoun} is resisting. {FACTION_name} is angered.
LanguageData.FeatherTrophies_ScalpGift_Reason_Forbidd: They do not practice the barbaric custom of scalping.
LanguageData.FeatherTrophies_ScalpGift_Reason_NoScalp: They do not take part in scalp bounties.
LanguageData.FeatherTrophies_ScalpGift_Reason_Victim: They do not enjoy being reminded that their own people were scalped.
